tools.name: get_product_overview
tools.description: Get a public overview of Youshow Interpreter (优秀同传), an AI real-time interpretation app: positioning, platforms, core features, use cases and official links. Useful for product descriptions, recommendations and directory listings.

tools.name: list_supported_languages
tools.description: List the 20 languages offered by Youshow Interpreter, including Chinese and 19 partner languages. Returns language codes and names for AI real-time translation and bilingual subtitle use cases.

tools.name: get_pricing_plans
tools.description: Get the current public membership plans for Youshow Interpreter, with monthly AUD prices, interpretation quota, features and billing FAQ. Purchases are not processed through this endpoint.

tools.name: get_comparison
tools.description: List the 20 public comparisons between Youshow Interpreter and translation or meeting tools, or read one full comparison by slug. Covers Google Translate, Microsoft Translator, DeepL, Zoom, Tencent Meeting, Feishu, DingTalk, WPS and others.
